content: मात्र {%a.%} (-त्रा, -त्री|{%f.%}) [मा-त्रन्] An affix added to nouns in the sense of ‘measuring as much as’, ‘as high or long, or broad as’, ‘reaching as far as’, as in ऊरुमात्री भित्तिः; पञ्चदशयोजनमात्रमध्वांनमतिचक्राम <ls>K.</ls>; (in this sense the word may as well be considered to be मात्रा at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> <ab>q. v.</ab> below). .{@-त्रः@} A Brāhmaṇa of the lower order (by birth). .{@-त्रम्@} .²1 A measure, whether of length, breadth, height, size, space, distance or number; अग्रे तिष्ठत मात्रं मे <ls>Bhāg. 6. 11. 5</ls>; usually at the end of comp, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} अङ्गुलिमात्रम् a ‘fingerʼs breadth’; किंचिन्मात्रं गत्वा ‘to some distance’; क्रोशमात्रे ‘at the distance of a Krośa’, रेखामात्रमपि ‘even the breadth of a line, as much as a line’; रेखामात्रमपि क्षुण्णादा मनोर्वर्त्मनः परम् (न व्यतीयुः) <ls>R. 1. 17</ls>; so क्षणमात्रम्, निमिषमात्रम् ‘the space of an instant’, शतमात्र ‘a hundred in number’; so गजमात्र ‘as high or big as an elephant’; तालमात्र, यवमात्र <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The full measure of anything, the whole or entire class of things, totality; जीवमात्रम् or प्राणिमात्रम् ‘the entire class of living beings’; मनुष्यमात्रो मर्त्यः ‘every man is mortal’; वस्तुमात्रपक्षकोऽनुपसंहारी (हेतुः) <ls>Tarka K.</ls>; मानुषमात्रदुष्करं कर्मानुष्ठितम् <ls>Dk.</ls> .²3 The simple measure of anything, the one thing and no more, often translatable by ‘mere’, ‘only’, ‘even’; जातिमात्रेण <ls>H. 1. 58</ls> ‘by mere caste’, टिट्टिभमात्रेण समुद्रो व्याकुलीकृतः <ls n="H.">2. 149</ls> ‘by a mere wag-tail’, वाचामात्रेण जाप्यसे <ls>Ś. 2</ls> ‘merely by words’; so अर्थमात्रम्, संमानमात्रम् <ls>Pt. 1. 83</ls>; used with past participles मात्र may be translated by ‘as soon as’, ‘no sooner than’, ‘just’; विद्धमात्रः <ls>R. 5. 51</ls> ‘as soon as pierced’; ‘when just pierced’; भुक्तमात्रे ‘just after eating’; प्रविष्टमात्र एव तत्रभवति <ls>Ś. 3</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 An element, elementary matter; अहं पयो ज्योतिरथानिलो नभो मात्राणि देवा मन इन्द्रियाणि <ls>Bhāg. 10. 59. 31</ls>.
